# Stochastic and Frequency-Domain bERG Augmentation

This repository contains the scripts and models implemented for background electroretinogram (bERG) data augmentation using stochastic and frequency domains.

For more details on the methodology, results, and context of this research, please refer to our preprint:
📄 **[Link to Preprint on SSRN](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6960239)**

## Repository Contents

This project primarily consists of three core scripts:

### 1. `Model FFT+CNN`
Contains the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture combined with the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). This script defines the main classification model we used to evaluate the signals.

### 2. `optimization_grid_search`
Script responsible for performing the grid search. Its main function is to find and optimize the ideal parameters for the stochastic generative model.

### 3. `Stochastic_generator`
This script contains the complete stochastic generative model. Its execution includes and automates all the processing steps, feature extraction, and synthetic signal generation illustrated in the diagram below.
